ety.text: The word has not been attested before 1731 and lacks clear cognates in other Slavic languages. Possibly inherited from Proto-Slavic *svьrkati, an alternative form of *(s)kvьrčěti, as a result of a linguistic shift where the word for cricket (сверчок) came to describe flashing light. This evolution likely occurred either through a conceptual confusion of crickets with fireflies or as a natural linguistic phenomenon where auditory terms are transferred to visual perceptions.
